readback_body:
## Description

The trusted Staging→Main promotion PR `#3565` repeatedly fails `E2E / Tests` at `scripts/staging-convergence-pr.mjs:92` with `untrusted or stale Staging promotion E2E source` before any browser assertions, even when a newly synced `staging` HEAD contains the current `main` ancestor. Example: [run 43711468704](https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/actions/runs/43711468704) on `6fbc900cb1cf10b14c142cc3bea0ad165de6f4f2`.

## Root cause

`issue-e2e-selection-entry.mjs` deliberately resolves the **current protected main tip** (`currentBaseSha`) for E2E planning, because a PR webhook's `pull_request.base.sha` can lag when main advances. But `promotionE2ESelection` requires `baseSha===pr.base.sha`. A legitimate authenticated event with stale base SHA is rejected even when its old SHA is an ancestor of the verified current main tip and the verified staging head contains that tip.

The independent `issue-e2e-source-attestation.mjs` already refuses ingest if claimed `base_sha` differs from the independently fetched current PR base. Do not weaken that attest-and-rerun guarantee.

## Location / single owner

`scripts/staging-convergence-pr.mjs`, function `promotionE2ESelection`; its self-test and existing `issue-e2e-selection-entry` / `issue-e2e-source-attestation` contracts. No new workflow, agent, synthetic requirement association or gate.

## Fix

- Accept a stale **authenticated PR event base** only if it is an ancestor of the live protected main tip that the planner has selected; the selected current main must itself be an ancestor of the exact staged PR head.
- Preserve the Publisher bot identity, exact repository/ref identities, immutable Main/Lane ancestry floors, exact checked-out head, deleted E2E ID refusal, canonical digest, and trusted ingest equality with the **live** GitHub PR base.
- Add a positive deterministic fixture for a legitimate stale webhook base and negatives for future/nonancestor/forged base identities, unrelated pins and removed tests.

## Success Criteria

- [ ] SC-01: An authenticated native promotion with a stale-but-ancestor PR event base produces a deterministic current-main/exact-head E2E plan; a newer future or unrelated base is denied.
- [ ] SC-02: Current-head source provenance, Publisher identity and all existing fail-closed negative tests remain intact; a base update **after** the selected run is still rejected by the independent trusted ingest.
- [ ] SC-03: Source-bound Quality / E2E / Case Smoke tests pass on the repair PR; this code fix does **not** substitute for the exact-current-SHA Staging Artifacts and Requirement Acceptance needed before #3565 promotion.

## Acceptance Plan

```yaml
acceptance:
  SC-01:
    when: pr
    method: agent
  SC-02:
    when: pr
    method: agent
  SC-03:
    when: pr
    method: agent
```

## Acceptance Report

| Criterion | Result | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| SC-01 | Pending | Source-bound stale/forged-base fixtures |
| SC-02 | Pending | Authenticated ingest and negative fixtures |
| SC-03 | Pending | Exact-PR-head CI plus separate staging deployment proof |

## E2E Verification

### New
- none: trust-boundary/source-plan code only; no runnable browser spec added

**Status:** Approved for repair; no merge/acceptance bypass.
